subject: Invite plan + waitlist strategy for Aug '28 developer webinar
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invite plan + waitlist strategy for Aug '28 developer webinar

Morning team —

Drafting the invite sequence for the Aug 22 developer webinar ("Scaling LLM Inference: cost vs latency tradeoffs"). Two quick asks before I lock the English copy and mapping: 

1) Waitlist cap: product has confirmed we can host 750 live seats; recommend we open with 500 invite seats + 250 waitlist seats. If converted waitlist > 100 by Aug 10, we convert a second live batch and trigger an additional reminder flow. Thoughts?

2) Segmentation + tracking: Ben, can you confirm we can do cohort-level tracking tokens so we can A/B SMS reminder vs. email-only? We want separate UTM_campaign values per cohort and a fallback deep-link to the recording for no-shows.

Attached draft sequence (v3) — quick skim for cadence and CTAs would be great. Plan: initial invite, 3-day reminder, 1-day reminder, same-day 2-hour reminder, and a waitlist-specific ping when seats open.

I copied Marissa for copy tweaks and sponsor coordination. If we want a sponsor promo block (Acme AI), we need the logo and 30-word blurb by EOD July 20.

Thanks,
Olga
Marketing Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: invite_sequence_v3.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-18T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invite plan + waitlist strategy for Aug '28 developer webinar

+1 on the 500/250 split — sensible. A couple implementation notes: 

- Cohort tokens: we can generate cohort_id tokens (cohort_1...cohort_5) and map them to UTM_campaign values. That mapping goes into tracking_map.csv (attached).
- SMS fallback: we'll reserve a small phone pool for high-touch accounts (enterprise leads). SMS will be an opt-in in the RSVP flow.
- Deep-link fingerprinting: suggest we test a "link_fingerprint" parameter so we can route returning clicks straight to the attendee's session page (helps with pre-warming).

I've added a sample tracking map and a short implementation notes doc. If we want to run the SMS vs email experiment, we should split cohorts by MQL score > 60 and <= 60.

Ben
Growth Ops

[Attachment: tracking_map.csv (csv)]
